<?php
// E2E probe (test only): stands in for the gateway. Records what the plugin sends (flags only, never a key, token or card number).
// The sale reply is shaped like the gateway's real reply: a vault id, and NO card fields (no cc_number, cc_exp, cc_type).
function cz_scn() { return (string) get_option( 'cz_scn', 'lookup_ok' ); }
add_filter( 'pre_http_request', function ( $pre, $args, $url ) {
	$url = (string) $url;
	$is_tx = ( false !== strpos( $url, 'transact.php' ) );
	$is_q  = ( false !== strpos( $url, 'query.php' ) );
	if ( ! $is_tx && ! $is_q ) { return $pre; }
	parse_str( is_string( $args['body'] ) ? $args['body'] : http_build_query( (array) $args['body'] ), $b );
	$log = get_option( 'cz_log', array() );
	$ok = array( 'headers' => array(), 'response' => array( 'code' => 200, 'message' => 'OK' ), 'cookies' => array(), 'filename' => null );
	if ( $is_q ) {
		$log[] = array( 'call' => 'query', 'report_type' => $b['report_type'] ?? null, 'has_vault_id' => ! empty( $b['customer_vault_id'] ) );
		update_option( 'cz_log', $log, false );
		if ( 'lookup_ok' === cz_scn() || 'novault' === cz_scn() ) {
			return $ok + array( 'body' => '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><nm_response><customer_vault><customer id="x"><customer_vault_id>V1</customer_vault_id><cc_number>4xxxxxxxxxxx1111</cc_number><cc_exp>1230</cc_exp><cc_type>Visa</cc_type></customer></customer_vault></nm_response>' );
		}
		return $ok + array( 'body' => 'Authentication Failed' );
	}
	$log[] = array( 'call' => 'sale', 'customer_vault' => $b['customer_vault'] ?? null, 'has_token' => ! empty( $b['payment_token'] ), 'type' => $b['type'] ?? null );
	update_option( 'cz_log', $log, false );
	$body = 'response=1&responsetext=SUCCESS&authcode=123456&transactionid=T' . wp_rand( 1000, 9999 ) . '&avsresponse=N&cvvresponse=M&orderid=' . ( $b['orderid'] ?? '' ) . '&type=sale&response_code=100';
	if ( ! empty( $b['customer_vault'] ) && 'novault' !== cz_scn() ) { $body .= '&customer_vault_id=V' . wp_rand( 100000, 999999 ); }
	return $ok + array( 'body' => $body );
}, 10, 3 );
add_action( 'wp_loaded', function () {
	if ( isset( $_GET['cz_set'] ) ) { update_option( 'cz_scn', sanitize_key( $_GET['cz_set'] ) ); delete_option( 'cz_log' ); header( 'Content-Type: application/json' ); echo '{"ok":true}'; exit; }
	if ( empty( $_GET['cz_state'] ) ) { return; }
	header( 'Content-Type: application/json' );
	$u = get_user_by( 'login', 'shopper' );
	$orders = wc_get_orders( array( 'customer_id' => $u->ID, 'limit' => 1, 'orderby' => 'id', 'order' => 'DESC' ) );
	$o = $orders ? $orders[0] : null;
	$notes = $o ? array_map( function ( $n ) { return preg_replace( '/\s+/', ' ', wp_strip_all_tags( $n->content ) ); }, wc_get_order_notes( array( 'order_id' => $o->get_id() ) ) ) : array();
	$toks = array_map( function ( $t ) { return array( 'last4' => $t->get_last4(), 'type' => $t->get_card_type(), 'exp' => $t->get_expiry_month() . '/' . $t->get_expiry_year() ); }, array_values( WC_Payment_Tokens::get_customer_tokens( $u->ID, 'cardz3n_gateway' ) ) );
	$logs = array();
	foreach ( glob( WC_LOG_DIR . '*cardz3n*.log' ) ?: array() as $f ) { foreach ( file( $f ) as $line ) { if ( false !== stripos( $line, 'saved method' ) ) { $logs[] = trim( preg_replace( '/^\S+\s+/', '', $line ) ); } } }
	echo wp_json_encode( array( 'order_id' => $o ? $o->get_id() : 0, 'order_status' => $o ? $o->get_status() : null, 'notes' => $notes, 'tokens' => $toks, 'gateway_calls' => get_option( 'cz_log', array() ), 'log_lines' => $logs ) );
	exit;
} );
